title: 8-round AES-192: Two-byte related-key schedule difference

target.description: Standard AES-192 key expansion k0 through k8, including whitening; Table2 uses column-major byte numbering.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown AES-192 master keys K and K'=K XOR Delta, where Delta[0]=Delta[8]=a!=0 and the other22 bytes are0. Initial whitening is k0; round subkeys are k1,... .
setting.key_population: General unknown key pair with attacker-chosen nonzero a; b,c are actual key-dependent S-box output differences, not independently chosen subkeys.

time.note: Structural or conditional statistical statement, not an attack-resource measurement.

success.description: Parameters describe a structural identity or conditional random-elimination model.

evidence.locator: Printed pp.18–19 Section3 Table2; pp.21,24–26 b/c and schedule-relation paragraphs
evidence.interpretation: Complete original proceedings reviewed. Source-convention boundaries, total queries across the two keys, partial output and native accounting are kept explicit.

limitations: Independent local checks cover the AES key schedule and deterministic components. Full cryptanalytic searches, resource calibration and success rates have not been reproduced.

property.statement: For DeltaK active at bytes0 and8 with the same nonzero a, the complete k0,...,k8 difference pattern is determined by a and two actual nonzero S-box differences b,c.
property.quantifier: For every standard AES-192 master key and every nonzero a, with b,c evaluated from that key's schedule.
property.scope: b=S(k5[12]) XOR S(k5[12] XOR a); c=S(k7[7]) XOR S(k7[7] XOR b). The schedule is not an independently selected related-subkey oracle.

parameters.name: Master-key difference
parameters.meaning: All other22 byte differences are zero.

parameters.name: Possible nonzero output differences
parameters.reported: 127 for each fixed nonzero input difference
parameters.meaning: 126 DDT outputs have2 preimages, one has4; the127 values are not uniformly likely.

parameters.name: Key-byte bridges
parameters.meaning: Allow the first/second eight-round attack to compute b,c from the guessed material.

parameters.name: Seven-round bridge
parameters.meaning: Used by the Section6 equality-based attack.

validation.description: Local tests check all9 Table2 subkeys on512 standard related-key pairs and all255 nonzero AES S-box difference supports.
